subject: Access control dossier request and sampling schedule
messages:
From: Tina Park <tina.park@blueoceanhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueOcean Health Security <security@blueoceanhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Access control evidence intake for SOC2 scoping

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 scoping we're collecting evidence for SSO/SAML, SCIM syncs, and least-privilege proof. We've prepared a small sampling plan (attached) and a short timeline.

Can Redwood provide: 
- A representative SAML assertion log (1-2 examples) showing NameID, attributes, and timestamps;
- SCIM delta export for the last 7 days for at least two service accounts;
- RBAC/role ownership matrix for production tenant "boh-prod" with the owner of each role;
- Notes on any delegated admin or cross-tenant admin mappings.

Ideal delivery: next Tuesday EOD (2026-12-15) but we can accept a staged delivery. Please CC the people who will own the technical handoff.

Thanks,
Tina Park
Security & Compliance Manager
BlueOcean Health

Attachment: boh-soc2-scope-plan.pdf (1 page)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Tina Park <tina.park@blueoceanhealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access control evidence intake for SOC2 scoping

Hi Tina — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide a scoped package. Quick notes and asks up front so we can stage delivery: 

1) SAML assertions: we'll extract two assertion samples covering (a) normal user login and (b) service-to-service SAML exchange. These will be redacted to remove PII (we'll replace NameID salts with tokens).
2) SCIM delta: we can pull delta records for the last 7 days for the service accounts you named — we'll include timestamps and the attribute diffs in NDJSON.
3) RBAC ownership matrix: we'll export a role->member->owner table from our internal provisioning DB and include a short narrative for any inferred delegated admin roles.
4) Evidence format: CSV / NDJSON / XLSX attachments as appropriate.

Can you confirm whether BlueOcean prefers full assertion XML or a parsed CSV/columns view? Also, do you want shared Drive access or direct file attachments in the email?

We expect to deliver a first tranche (SAML samples + short narrative) by Tue 12/15 morning, and the larger payload (SCIM deltas + RBAC matrix) by Thu 12/17 EOD. If that timeline works we'll proceed.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Security Engineer, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Tina Park <tina.park@blueoceanhealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access control evidence intake for SOC2 scoping

Hi all — technical update and what I'll attach in the drop: 

- SAML assertion samples: attached as sso-assertion-sample.csv (we include both raw XML snippet column and parsed attribute columns). We redacted email addresses and replaced with stable tokens. Each record includes AssertionID, Issuer, NameID(token), AuthnInstant, and Attributes.
- SCIM delta snapshot: attached scim-delta-snapshot.jsonl (NDJSON) with event_type, timestamp, resourceType, and attribute_delta fields. We've stripped long hashes and replaced them with placeholders per our standard redaction.
- RBAC matrix: rbac-ownership-matrix.xlsx includes role name, environment tag (prod/stage), member_count, explicit_owners, last_owner_update. There's a short 'owner_notes.txt' tab explaining inferred delegated admins.

One callout: there are ~12 service accounts in boh-prod that are federated vs local. For federated service accounts the SCIM delta sometimes shows ephemeral provisioning entries; in the RBAC matrix we've marked these with a 'federated' flag and included the SAML provider mapping.

Logistics: I've uploaded the full payload to a shared Drive folder (link below) and included a signed hash.txt for integrity. If you prefer encrypted attachments we can provide a PGP bundle; let me know.

Attachment stubs: sso-assertion-sample.csv, scim-delta-snapshot.jsonl, rbac-ownership-matrix.xlsx

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3C_blueocean-iam

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Engineer, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: Tina Park <tina.park@blueoceanhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access control evidence intake for SOC2 scoping

Rishi / Sofia — this is excellent, thank you. Quick confirmation: 
- We received sso-assertion-sample.csv and validated that the AssertionID and AuthnInstant columns align with our sampling queries. Good.
- SCIM delta NDJSON looks in-scope; we'll run the delta correlation next week.
- RBAC matrix is exactly what we needed; one ask: can you expand the "owner_notes" entries for any role flagged as 'federated' with the external IdP name and contact?

If you can drop that small expansion by Monday EOD we'll close the intake and mark the ticket as ready for SOC2 artifact review. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best regards,
Tina Park
Security & Compliance Manager
BlueOcean Health

Forwarded attachment: boh-soc2-scope-plan.pdf (original intake), hash.txt (integrity), sso-assertion-sample.csv (attached)
